title: Residential Electricity Supply Plan Pricing Schedule
content:
Every Beacon Ridge plan sold under Residential Electricity Supply has one pricing structure, one term length and one monthly service fee, as set out in the schedule below. All computed supply charges and bill credits are rounded half up to the cent.

## Schedule A: pricing structure by plan

| Plan | Pricing structure | Term (months) | Monthly service fee (USD) | Introductory-rate cycles |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | variable | 0 (month-to-month) | 4.95 | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | fixed | 6 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | fixed | 12 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | fixed | 24 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | fixed time-of-use | 12 | 9.95 | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | fixed | 12 | 2.95 | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | fixed | 24 | 0.00 | 0 |

A term of 0 months means month-to-month service with no term. The introductory-rate cycles are the number of initial billing cycles billed at the introductory rate stored on the agreement before monthly variable pricing applies; 0 means the plan has no introductory rate. The monthly service fee is a flat supplier fee billed once per billing cycle.

## Schedule B: time-of-use and metering

| Plan | Off-peak window (local clock) | Off-peak rate multiplier | Advanced (smart) meter required |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | not applicable | 1.00 | no |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | not applicable | 1.00 | no |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | not applicable | 1.00 | no |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | not applicable | 1.00 | no |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | 21:00-05:59 | 0.00 | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | not applicable | 1.00 | no |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | not applicable | 1.00 | no |

The off-peak rate multiplier is applied to the contract rate for off-peak kWh. A multiplier of 1.00 means off-peak usage is billed at the contract rate; a multiplier of 0.00 means off-peak kWh carry no energy charge. Only Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 has an off-peak window, and only that plan requires a premise meter that delivers interval data.

## Rounding

Every computed charge and credit on a Residential Electricity Supply agreement is rounded half up to the cent: a third decimal of 5 or more raises the cent, a third decimal below 5 leaves it. For example, a hypothetical computed amount of 41.825 USD becomes 41.83 USD, and a hypothetical 41.824 USD becomes 41.82 USD.
